description: A serene primary bedroom photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a centered symmetrical view of the bed against the far wall. A tall black-framed French door on the left wall opens to a winter landscape of bare trees in snow, flanked by cream linen floor-length drapery. Three small multi-pane windows with black steel frames and grey linen Roman shades line the back wall above the bed. The bed is a generously sized upholstered platform in warm cream bouclé fabric with a tall channeled headboard, dressed with crisp white bedding, a charcoal wool throw draped across the foot, and layered pillows in ivory, grey, and warm caramel. A low rounded bouclé bench in heathered grey sits across the foot of the bed. On each bedside, a small walnut nightstand holds minimal decoration — a single slender vase with a bare branch on the left, a small ceramic object on the right. The floor is pale washed wide-plank oak beneath a natural flat-weave area rug. A ribbed organic gourd-shaped diffuser glows warmly above the center of the room, suspended from the ceiling on a thin cord, casting a soft warm halo into the vault. The mood is deeply serene, winter-cozy, and refined.
